faq.q: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a: Yes. Upgrade or downgrade from your account in one click. Changes take effect immediately with prorated billing.

faq.q: Does the free trial require a credit card?
faq.a: No, no card required for the 7-day trial. You only enter payment details if you choose to continue.

faq.q: What happens if I reach my generation limit?
faq.a: You receive a notification at 80% usage. You can purchase additional credits or upgrade your plan instantly.

faq.q: Do I own the generated images?
faq.a: Yes, you retain full rights to all content created. Commercial use is included in all plans, with no restrictions.
Annual billing is charged once at the start of the period. You get a 20% discount compared to monthly billing.

whatIs.title: What is it?
whatIs.text1: It's your photo studio... without the studio. Upload your image, choose a setting — minimalist, design, lifestyle, or inspired by your brand — and instantly get a 4K render ready to publish.
whatIs.text2: No more lighting, white backgrounds, and reflections to correct for three hours.

whyAdopt.title: Why adopt it?
whyAdopt.benefit1: Save days of shooting: no need to rent a studio or wait for a photographer.
whyAdopt.benefit2: Reduce production costs: a studio image costs $0.08 to generate, versus hundreds of dollars in real shooting.
whyAdopt.benefit3: Standardize your visuals: a consistent style for your entire catalog, effortlessly.

howToUse.title: How to use it?
howToUse.step2: Choose a studio setting or lifestyle environment.
howToUse.step3: Let our AI balance the light, perspective and shadows.
howToUse.step4: Download your final image, ready to use.

quotes.quote1: Your photo studio, now in the cloud.
quotes.quote2: From concept to final render, in less than a minute.
quotes.quote3: Images worthy of a photographer, without a photographer.

mannequinVirtuel.title: Virtual Model
mannequinVirtuel.subtitle: Humanize your visuals with realistic and personalized models.
mannequinVirtuel.conceptImageAlt: Virtual Model output — product with AI model

whatIs.title: What is it?
whatIs.text1: It's the fusion between fashion and machine. You choose the ideal profile (gender, body type, style, emotion), and the AI generates a model consistent with your image and brand universe.
whatIs.text2: No more castings or endless retouching.

whyAdopt.title: Why adopt it?
whyAdopt.benefit1: Create identification: a face, a posture, an atmosphere. Your products come to life.
whyAdopt.benefit2: Vary infinitely: change model, look, setting in a few clicks.
whyAdopt.benefit3: Stay consistent: keep a uniform visual style across all your campaigns.

howToUse.title: How to use it?
howToUse.step1: Choose your product or generated image.
howToUse.step2: Select the model type: age, origin, pose, clothing style.
howToUse.step3: Adjust the light and position, let the AI harmonize everything.

quotes.quote1: Visuals that breathe life, without a human model.
quotes.quote2: Say goodbye to castings, hello to creativity.
quotes.quote3: The ideal model exists. It awaits your prompt.

motionStudio.title: Motion Studio
motionStudio.subtitle: Go from image to motion in one click.
motionStudio.conceptImageAlt: Motion Studio output — animated product video
motionStudio.workflowImageAlt: Motion Studio interface — animation style selection

whatIs.title: What is it?
whatIs.text1: It's the logical next step: give breath to your visuals. Motion Studio converts your product images into realistic, cinematic or advertising videos, ready for TikTok, Instagram or your site.
whatIs.text2: From static to dynamic, in seconds.

whyAdopt.title: Why adopt it?
whyAdopt.benefit1: Multiply formats: a single image becomes a video, a spot or a story.
whyAdopt.benefit2: Capture attention: videos get 3× more engagement than still images.
whyAdopt.benefit3: Simplify production: no team, no camera, just an idea.

howToUse.title: How to use it?
howToUse.step1: Import your image or scene created in AI Studio.
howToUse.step2: Choose a motion style (cinematic, slow motion, panoramic, reveal, etc.).
howToUse.step3: Let the AI generate a smooth and realistic clip.
howToUse.step4: Download in 4K, ready for your campaigns.

quotes.quote2: From photo to advertising spot, in one click.
